The strongest result from this continuation is a constructive way for acquired knowledge to determine a further measurement—and for that measurement to warrant subsequent predictions without identifying the entire hidden system. The construction survives the mathematical challenges. Its practical advantage remains UNKNOWN: conventional retaining subspace methods can implement the same machinery, and the independently inspected apparatus does not yet establish the complete physical access it requires.

The important change is that the learner measures an approximation’s remaining error in a physical norm, rather than treating a successful fit to previously observed outcomes as evidence that the representation will remain valid.

1. The scientific obstruction

The external scientific problem is characterizing a quantum environment when measuring it changes its state. Repeated Ramsey measurements can steer the environment and produce dependent records. Consequently, resetting the observed sensor does not necessarily restore the environment from which the next experiment begins. Qiu and colleagues explicitly analyze this effect, including persistent sectors and metastable behavior. 
arxiv.org

That creates two distinct acquisition problems:

Learning predictions for the experiments already performed.
Learning how an operation changes the information needed by a later experiment.

The earlier exchange construction already demonstrated why these differ. An event can have the correct, state-independent probability while changing the hidden state in a way that invalidates its proposed composition with another operation.

6. What the independent apparatus establishes

The source inspection produced useful support and a clear boundary.

The NV experiments contain actual conditional electron/nuclear gates, and a related nuclear-ancilla interferometry experiment demonstrates coherent control with explicit hyperfine-phase compensation. These support the plausibility of a forward-history comparison circuit. They do not establish arbitrary coherent hidden-bath words with a common implementation across partner branches. Finite pulses, ancilla-dependent errors, and bath evolution during control are material parts of the interface. 
arxiv.org
+1

The scientific comparison also became stronger:

Meinel and colleagues already measure a fourth-order quantum bath correlation. Reproducing that quantity would not establish a new capability. 
arxiv.org
Jin and Ma already acquire observable channel modes from repeated outcome and correlation statistics, using matrix-pencil methods for subsequent parameter estimation. That is a substantive retaining baseline. 
arxiv.org
Once coherent overlaps and residual experiments are available, conventional retaining subspace methods can acquire the same representation and use the same verifier.

Required input	Status in the inspected system

Ancilla coherence through the complete control history	Not established for the proposed family
Repeated common initial bath law with a valid concentration contract	Not established

Background and control errors small enough for useful verification	UNKNOWN
A sufficiently compact, well-conditioned representation for consequential tasks	UNKNOWN

These are not supplied by the proof.

html:
The strongest result from this continuation is a constructive way for acquired knowledge to determine a further measurement—and for that measurement to warrant subsequent predictions without identifying the entire hidden system. The construction survives the mathematical challenges. Its practical advantage remains UNKNOWN: conventional retaining subspace methods can implement the same machinery, and the independently inspected apparatus does not yet establish the complete physical access it requires.

The important change is that the learner measures an approximation’s remaining error in a physical norm, rather than treating a successful fit to previously observed outcomes as evidence that the representation will remain valid.

1. The scientific obstruction

The external scientific problem is characterizing a quantum environment when measuring it changes its state. Repeated Ramsey measurements can steer the environment and produce dependent records. Consequently, resetting the observed sensor does not necessarily restore the environment from which the next experiment begins. Qiu and colleagues explicitly analyze this effect, including persistent sectors and metastable behavior. arxiv.org

That creates two distinct acquisition problems:

  • Learning predictions for the experiments already performed.
  • Learning how an operation changes the information needed by a later experiment.

The earlier exchange construction already demonstrated why these differ. An event can have the correct, state-independent probability while changing the hidden state in a way that invalidates its proposed composition with another operation.

I pushed the recognition issue further. There are stationary hidden instruments that agree on every accessible experiment through length LLL, including the same event probabilities and finite preparation–suffix tables, yet disagree on a subsequent first-event operation by

(1−p)L.(1-p)^L.(1−p)L.

For ppp of order 1/L1/L1/L, that discrepancy remains of constant size. Perfect short-history fits therefore cannot, on their own, establish the required longer-history action.

This is a precise access obstruction. It does not imply that full system identification is necessary. It identifies the missing information: evidence that bounds the part of an operation’s action that the current representation misses.

2. A construction that acquires that missing information

Suppose an experiment can coherently compare two executable control histories of the same duration. For a common initial environment state ρ\rhoρ, this measures

G(v,w)=Tr⁡ ⁣(ρUv†Uw).G(v,w)=\operatorname{Tr}\!\left(\rho U_v^\dagger U_w\right).G(v,w)=Tr(ρUv†​Uw​).

Both histories can evolve forward. The formula does not require physically reversing the unknown bath dynamics.

These measurements define inner products between features

xw=Uwρ.x_w=U_w\sqrt{\rho}.xw​=Uw​ρ​.

The learner receives overlaps; it does not receive the hidden state coordinates, Hamiltonian, or total dimension.

At a given time, select a frame VtV_tVt​ of actual executable histories. Acquire its Gram matrix and the cross-Gram matrix for an action aaa:

Gt=Vt†Vt,Bt,a=Vt+1†UaVt.G_t=V_t^\dagger V_t,\qquad B_{t,a}=V_{t+1}^\dagger U_aV_t.Gt​=Vt†​Vt​,Bt,a​=Vt+1†​Ua​Vt​.

For any fitted coefficient map TTT, its exact residual Gram is

R(T)=Gt−Bt,a†T−T†Bt,a+T†Gt+1T=(UaVt−Vt+1T)†(UaVt−Vt+1T).\begin{aligned} R(T) &=G_t-B_{t,a}^\dagger T-T^\dagger B_{t,a} +T^\dagger G_{t+1}T\\ &=(U_aV_t-V_{t+1}T)^\dagger (U_aV_t-V_{t+1}T). \end{aligned}R(T)​=Gt​−Bt,a†​T−T†Bt,a​+T†Gt+1​T=(Ua​Vt​−Vt+1​T)†(Ua​Vt​−Vt+1​T).​

The second line is decisive: R(T)R(T)R(T) is positive, and an omitted direction contributes to it even when that direction was invisible to the previous ordinary readouts.

If

R(T)⪯δ2Gt,R(T)\preceq \delta^2G_t,R(T)⪯δ2Gt​,

then

∥UaVtc−Vt+1Tc∥≤δ∥Vtc∥\|U_aV_tc-V_{t+1}Tc\| \le \delta\|V_tc\|∥Ua​Vt​c−Vt+1​Tc∥≤δ∥Vt​c∥

for every vector in the acquired span. No upper bound on the unknown ambient dimension is needed for this statement.

This is not a cheap certificate of arbitrary class membership. It is a warrant on a particular acquired span, obtained through a stronger measurement interface.

Composition requires one further correction

An arbitrary fitted map can amplify errors. I retained that failure mode and repaired it explicitly.

If the raw fitted map has warranted residual δ0\delta_0δ0​, replacing it by

T‾=T1+δ0\overline T=\frac{T}{1+\delta_0}T=1+δ0​T​

makes it contractive in the true physical Gram norm. Its residual is then bounded by

δ‾≤2δ01+δ0.\overline\delta\le \frac{2\delta_0}{1+\delta_0}.δ≤1+δ0​2δ0​​.

For these contractive maps, a new control word satisfies

∥xw−x^w∥≤∑tδt,at.\|x_w-\widehat x_w\| \le \sum_t\delta_{t,a_t}.∥xw​−xw​∥≤t∑​δt,at​​.

The resulting overlap prediction error is bounded by the two words’ error sums.

A finite collection of action inequalities therefore warrants all words within the acquired alphabet and horizon, including words selected after acquisition. Additional actions and longer horizons require further acquisition.

The full proof and finite measurement-error treatment are in LAYERED_COHERENT_ACTION_ACQUISITION.md.

3. What the acquired knowledge enables next

The fitted coefficients can specify a new physical experiment.

For a residual column,

dj=Uavj−∑kTkjvk′,sj=1+∑k∣Tkj∣,d_j=U_av_j-\sum_kT_{kj}v'_k, \qquad s_j=1+\sum_k|T_{kj}|,dj​=Ua​vj​−k∑​Tkj​vk′​,sj​=1+k∑​∣Tkj​∣,

qj=∥dj∥2sj2.q_j=\frac{\|d_j\|^2}{s_j^2}.qj​=sj2​∥dj​∥2​.

S2=∑jsj2.S_2=\sum_js_j^2.S2​=j∑​sj2​.

The resulting event probability is

q=Tr⁡R(T)S2.q=\frac{\operatorname{Tr}R(T)}{S_2}.q=S2​TrR(T)​.

If a separately acquired conditioning bound gives Gt⪰gIG_t\succeq gIGt​⪰gI, then a valid upper confidence bound q+q_+q+​ yields

δ2≤S2q+g.\boxed{\delta^2\le \frac{S_2q_+}{g}.}δ2≤gS2​q+​​.​

This tests the entire learned span without supplying an oracle for its worst error direction. The coefficients learned in the first stage determine the interference experiment used in the second stage.

There is a substantial resource distinction here. A two-history interferometer does not automatically provide coherent selection among all the terms in a learned residual. The latter needs a larger coherent program register or a separately justified implementation. Preparation, control depth, coefficient precision, and consistency between these implementations all count.

The underlying coherent combination and measured-subspace machinery has established prior. I am not claiming that linear combinations of unitaries or projection-based learning are new. arxiv.org+1

4. The stronger task-relative version

Uniform validity for every possible word can cost much more than the scientific task needs. I therefore developed a second version that warrants a declared distribution of future experiments, without requiring uniform action closure.

Freeze:

  • An acquired final frame VVV.
  • A learned program that maps a control word www to coefficients c(w)c(w)c(w).
  • An executable distribution π\piπ of future control words.
  • A computable coefficient bound ∥c(w)∥1≤L\|c(w)\|_1\le L∥c(w)∥1​≤L.

Define

d(w)=∥xw−Vc(w)∥,s(w)=1+∥c(w)∥1.d(w)=\|x_w-Vc(w)\|, \qquad s(w)=1+\|c(w)\|_1.d(w)=∥xw​−Vc(w)∥,s(w)=1+∥c(w)∥1​.

It satisfies

EY=M:=Ew∼πd(w)2,EY2≤(1+L)2M.\mathbb EY=M:=\mathbb E_{w\sim\pi}d(w)^2, \qquad \mathbb EY^2\le (1+L)^2M.EY=M:=Ew∼π​d(w)2,EY2≤(1+L)2M.

There is no unknown normalizer, no enumeration of the full task space, and no supplied hidden-state decomposition.

The retaining comparison improved this construction

My initial version randomly discarded some successful outcomes to obtain a simple Bernoulli experiment. That construction was correct, but retaining the raw outcome and its weight is better:

Var⁡(Y)≤Var⁡(thinned estimator).\operatorname{Var}(Y) \le \operatorname{Var}(\text{thinned estimator}).Var(Y)≤Var(thinned estimator).

The inequality follows exactly by Rao–Blackwellization. I preserved the thinning construction as a valid but inferior attempt and made weighted retention the primary method.

For S=(1+L)2S=(1+L)^2S=(1+L)2, Y/S∈[0,1]Y/S\in[0,1]Y/S∈[0,1]. A bounded-variable Chernoff–KL confidence bound supplies an upper bound on MMM. This is not a binomial interval applied to fractional weighted counts.

Reuse for a genuinely subsequent acquisition

A warranted upper Gram matrix can be used to constrain the represented feature to have norm at most one. Then, for any bounded physical readout FFF with ∥F∥≤1\|F\|\le1∥F∥≤1,

Eπ∣⟨xw,Fxw⟩−⟨Vc(w),FVc(w)⟩∣≤2M.\mathbb E_\pi \left| \langle x_w,Fx_w\rangle - \langle Vc(w),FVc(w)\rangle \right| \le 2\sqrt M.Eπ​∣⟨xw​,Fxw​⟩−⟨Vc(w),FVc(w)⟩∣≤2M​.

A newly introduced, physically executable readout can be acquired through its small projected matrix

(OF)ij=Tr⁡ ⁣(ρUi†FUj).(O_F)_{ij} =\operatorname{Tr}\!\left(\rho U_i^\dagger F U_j\right).(OF​)ij​=Tr(ρUi†​FUj​).

The learner then predicts

f^F(w)=c(w)†OFc(w)\widehat f_F(w)=c(w)^\dagger O_Fc(w)f​F​(w)=c(w)†OF​c(w)

using the retained representation.

This is the concrete sequence of cumulative acquisition:

  1. Experience acquires a predictive representation.
  2. Its coefficients specify an error-measurement experiment.
  3. That measurement warrants a domain of reuse.
  4. The retained frame supports acquisition of a new readout without identifying the full hidden system.

The new readout matrix remains a paid experiment. Overlap access does not grant arbitrary bath observables.

The full distributional theorem is in DISTRIBUTIONAL_COHERENT_REPRESENTATION_WARRANT.md.

Its domain is deliberately limited

A known change of program distribution satisfying

π′(w)≤κπ(w)\pi'(w)\le\kappa\pi(w)π′(w)≤κπ(w)

gives

Eπ′d(w)2≤κM.\mathbb E_{\pi'}d(w)^2\le\kappa M.Eπ′​d(w)2≤κM.

An optimizer selecting an arbitrary rare word does not inherit a small-κ\kappaκ guarantee. Similarly, average prediction accuracy does not guarantee that every one of QQQ subsequent predictions is accurate. Requiring that stronger statement can restore a QQQ-dependent validation cost.

For one fixed average scientific quantity, direct Monte Carlo remains a strong comparator: it already has ordinary inverse-square sampling scaling and avoids representation startup. The potential repayment concerns repeated, changed tasks for which the acquired frame remains useful.

5. The hardest cost challenges

Small residuals can be expensive to recognize

Ordinary pairwise measurements may estimate a small squared residual by subtracting noisy quantities of order one.

I constructed an exact restricted-access example with leakage δ\deltaδ, while every informative available pair overlap changes only by order δ2\delta^2δ2. Independent measurements of those fixed pairs require

Ω(δ−4)\Omega(\delta^{-4})Ω(δ−4)

shots for constant-error discrimination.

The restriction matters. The executable audit also includes a longer coherent word that amplifies the distinction. The fourth-power result is therefore a lower bound for the specified fixed-pair experiment, not for every possible controller or learning algorithm.

Direct coherent residual measurement can improve the small-error verification scaling to order δ−2\delta^{-2}δ−2, subject to its stronger physical contract.

Detector background can remove that improvement

If the physical detector reports an event with probability

b+vq,b+vq,b+vq,

where b>0b>0b>0 is a false-positive background, distinguishing zero residual from a small residual has per-shot information of order q2/bq^2/bq2/b.

Even perfectly known background subtraction does not remove its fluctuations.

For the retained distributional estimator, the correct adjustment is

Yb=s(w)2(Z−b)v.Y_b=\frac{s(w)^2(Z-b)}{v}.Yb​=vs(w)2(Z−b)​.

At zero residual,

Var⁡(Yb)=b(1−b) Eπ[s(w)4]v2.\operatorname{Var}(Y_b) = \frac{b(1-b)\,\mathbb E_\pi[s(w)^4]}{v^2}.Var(Yb​)=v2b(1−b)Eπ​[s(w)4]​.

Thus fixed background can restore fourth-power residual-precision costs. The complete comparison must include the cost of suppressing or calibrating it.

A persistent bath does not supply independent initial ensembles

The exact counterexample is simple and consequential. Let one persistent sector bit be drawn with probability p=1/100p=1/100p=1/100. Repeated perfect QND measurements can reveal that bit, but they still supply only one draw of the population parameter.

With 10,000 repeated records, all outcomes are zero with probability 99/10099/10099/100. An incorrect independent-shot calculation would nevertheless report a 95% upper bound of approximately 0.00029950.00029950.0002995, excluding the true 0.010.010.01 overwhelmingly often.

Neither many records nor identical unconditional marginals supplies the independent preparation contract required by the verifier.

6. What the independent apparatus establishes

The source inspection produced useful support and a clear boundary.

The NV experiments contain actual conditional electron/nuclear gates, and a related nuclear-ancilla interferometry experiment demonstrates coherent control with explicit hyperfine-phase compensation. These support the plausibility of a forward-history comparison circuit. They do not establish arbitrary coherent hidden-bath words with a common implementation across partner branches. Finite pulses, ancilla-dependent errors, and bath evolution during control are material parts of the interface. arxiv.org+1

The scientific comparison also became stronger:

  • Meinel and colleagues already measure a fourth-order quantum bath correlation. Reproducing that quantity would not establish a new capability. arxiv.org
  • Jin and Ma already acquire observable channel modes from repeated outcome and correlation statistics, using matrix-pencil methods for subsequent parameter estimation. That is a substantive retaining baseline. arxiv.org
  • Once coherent overlaps and residual experiments are available, conventional retaining subspace methods can acquire the same representation and use the same verifier.

The unresolved physical requirements are therefore specific:

Required inputStatus in the inspected system
The same word implementation across partner and program branchesNot established
Ancilla coherence through the complete control historyNot established for the proposed family
Repeated common initial bath law with a valid concentration contractNot established
General multi-history residual selectorNot established
Background and control errors small enough for useful verificationUNKNOWN
A sufficiently compact, well-conditioned representation for consequential tasksUNKNOWN

These are not supplied by the proof.

7. Executable falsification and the resulting decision

The implementations tested the construction’s claims and its failure modes:

  • The layered residual identities, contraction repair, and new-word error bounds passed their algebraic checks.
